cycles.newHint: People with an active payroll profile in the scope are included once; their fixed components are copied from the profiles.
cycles.title: Cycle

cycle.manyCurrencies: Several currencies: totals stay separate per currency.
cycle.copied: {{copied}} line(s) copied as drafts to edit; {{skipped}} already here.
cycle.bulkHint: Everyone chosen gets the same line, or nobody does if one of them cannot (for example outside your sites).

actionHints.submit: The cycle is checked first; blocking errors stop it, warnings need your acknowledgement.
actionHints.return: The cycle goes back to the people who prepare it, with your reason.
actionHints.approve: The numbers are stored as a new version; installments in it are paid. Whoever sent it for review cannot approve it.
actionHints.lock: A locked cycle can be published to the employees.
actionHints.reopen: Published payslips are withdrawn and installments paid by this cycle are returned. Approving again creates a new version.
actionHints.cancel: A cancelled cycle is kept for the record and frees the period.

checks.title: Checks
checks.PARTIAL_PERIOD: Joined or left during the period
checks.NET_CHANGED: The net changed a lot from the previous cycle
checks.ATTENDANCE_CHANGED: Attendance changed after a suggestion was accepted

suggestions.title: From attendance
suggestions.hint: Nothing is added by itself: review each suggestion, choose the component and the amount, then accept it.

lines.noVariableComponents: Define a variable component in the payroll settings first.

reports.title: Reports
reports.hint: Each report shows only what it may: the payslip and the summary never show the extra allowances; the salary + allowances report is the only one with them.
reports.draftNote: Before approval the files are marked as a draft.
reports.excluded: {{count}} people outside your scope were left out.

import.title: Import from a spreadsheet
import.hint: Download the template, fill it in Excel, save it as CSV and choose it here. Every row is checked; nothing is saved unless every row is valid.
import.hasErrors: Nothing was saved. Fix these rows:

codes.EMPLOYEE_NOT_IN_CYCLE: this person is not in the cycle

doc.combinedNotNet: Salary + allowances is not the net salary.

profiles.title: People
profiles.hint: Each person's fixed components, with the date each value applies from - earlier cycles never change.
profiles.noFixedComponents: Define fixed components (such as the basic salary) in the payroll settings.
profiles.historyHint: A new value ends the previous one the day before; an empty amount ends the component.
profiles.statutoryHint: This is not the salary - enter the salary under "Basic salary" above. A fixed insurable wage replaces the basic salary for insurance only, within the limits.
profiles.applyFromHint: Usually the 1st of the month. Changes reach open cycles whose period is on or after this date by themselves; approved cycles do not change.
profiles.salaryHint: Type the amounts - Arabic digits are accepted. Unchanged values are not saved again; an emptied box ends the item.
profiles.tapToEdit: Tap anyone to add or edit their whole salary.
profiles.deleteItemConfirm: Remove “{{name}}” from this employee’s pay only? Other employees and approved cycles do not change.
profiles.legalNameArabicLabel: Employee name in Arabic (as on the ID card)
profiles.legalNameHint: This is the name on the payslip and payroll sheets, not the user name ({{user}}).
profiles.notInPayroll: This person is not in payroll (the owner is not paid a salary).

installments.title: Installments and advances
installments.hint: Each cycle adds the installment due ("installment 3 of 10") and the plan ends at a zero balance.
installments.name: Name

settings.title: Policies
settings.netChangeWarning: Warn when the net changes by more than (%)
settings.allowNegative: Allow a negative net (with a reason)
settings.autoLock: Lock a cycle when it is approved
settings.selfService: Employees view their published payslips in the app
settings.signatures: Show the prepared / reviewed / approved boxes
settings.appliesToNew: Changes apply to new cycles; every cycle keeps the policies it was created with.

components.title: Components
components.hint: Taxes and insurance are components you define: an amount, or a percentage of a base you choose. No country rates are built in.
components.name: Name
components.inNetLabel: Counts in the net salary (and shows on the payslip and the summary)
components.outsideNetHint: Outside the net it never shows on the payslip or the summary - only in the salary + allowances report.
components.inCombinedLabel: Shows in the salary + allowances report
components.prorateLabel: Prorated for part of a period
components.deductionPercentHint: A percentage deduction is between 0 and 100.
components.appliesToAllHint: Added in every new cycle for everyone with a payroll profile. A person's own value, when set, is used instead.
components.preTaxLabel: Taken off the taxable pay (before the tax)

requests.hint: Payslips your team asked for. One click sends the approved, stored payslip as a PDF to the person's registered email - the same version, nothing recalculated.
requests.confirmBody: The payslip of {{cycle}} will be sent as a PDF to {{name}} at {{email}}.
requests.sentInApp: The payslip is now in {{name}}'s app.

mine.askBody: Your manager will be told, and the payslip will come as a PDF to {{email}}.
mine.askBodyApp: Your request goes to payroll; once it is sent you will find the payslip here to view and save as PDF.

errors.noAuthority: You do not have this payroll permission for these people.
errors.notInPlan: Payroll is not in your organisation's plan.
errors.changedBySomeoneElse: Someone else changed this meanwhile. The page was reloaded - try again.
errors.periodTaken: A cycle already covers this period and scope.
errors.submitterCannotApprove: Whoever sent the cycle for review cannot approve it.
errors.notPublished: This payslip is not published from a locked cycle.
errors.alreadyAsked: You already asked for this payslip.
errors.beingSent: This payslip is being sent right now.
errors.notEditable: This cycle cannot be changed now.
errors.fileFailed: The file could not be made. Try again.
errors.statutoryRate: A rate must be between 0 and 100.
errors.statutoryBrackets: Brackets must rise in order, and the last has no upper limit.
errors.statutoryWage: The maximum insurable wage must not be below the minimum.
errors.basicCannotBeDeleted: The basic salary cannot be deleted.
errors.legalNameRequired: Enter the employee's official name - it is the name on the payslip.
errors.legalNameArabic: Write the name in Arabic letters only, as on the ID card.

exports.hint: Payslips of an approved or locked cycle are prepared on the server as one ZIP, each with its own serial number. You can leave the page; the file stays available for 7 days.

statutory.title: Insurance and taxes
statutory.hint: Calculated automatically in every new cycle under the chosen country's law. Every figure can be changed.
statutory.insuranceDeductible: Deduct the employee's insurance before tax
statutory.bracketsHint: Yearly brackets on taxable income after the exemption. The last bracket has no upper limit.
statutory.tiersHint: The high-income rule also applies ({{count}} levels): above a threshold the lower brackets fall away.
statutory.appliesToNew: Changes apply to new cycles only; earlier cycles keep their rules.
statutory.roundDown: Round the month's tax down to the whole unit

steps.title: Payroll in 3 steps
steps.hint: Steps 1 and 2 once; step 3 every month.
steps.oneTodo: Define the components (basic salary, allowances, deductions). Insurance and taxes come ready under Egyptian law and can be changed.
steps.statutoryOn: Insurance and taxes are calculated automatically.
steps.statutoryOff: Insurance and taxes are switched off.
steps.two: A payroll file for each employee
steps.twoTodo: Nobody has a payroll file yet - a cycle would be empty. Open the files and enter each person's basic salary.
steps.twoDone: {{done}} of {{total}} employees have a payroll file.
steps.twoNoAccess: Prepared by whoever manages payroll files.
steps.threeText: Create the cycle below → add the variable amounts and review the attendance suggestions → submit → someone else approves → lock and publish the payslips.
